reuse.why: Extends the existing getFillableCategories selection, but parses the tag with a hand-written FIXED_TAG regex instead of the tree's shared tag parser extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts, so #fixed may be recognised differently from the rest of the app.

duplication.why: The fixed-group exclusion is applied twice, once inside getFillableCategories and again by hand in copyPreviousMonth's own skip condition.

placement.why: The lookup sits in server/budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide eligibility helpers, though the tag parsing belongs with shared/tags.

scope.why: Only the eligibility rule, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Month-wide eligibility now lives in getFillableCategories plus a parallel condition list in copyPreviousMonth, and a private tag regex can drift from the app's tag semantics.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts keeps its own hidden/group_hidden/template/fixedIds checks instead of using getFillableCategories; FIXED_TAG regex bypasses extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The second application of the rule in copyPreviousMonth is an openly parallel condition, not a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is applied both in getFillableCategories and separately in copyPreviousMonth's own filter (both via getFixedCategoryIds), so the eligibility rule is not one shared definition.
